d: After moving to a new town, 11-year-old Peter and his friend Bill must team up with mysterious new girl Maggie and brave the woods on Halloween to face a monster born from their nightmares.
A crazed scientist invents an invisibility formula. He plans to use the formula to create an army of invisible zombies.
A crazed scientist accidentally turns himself into a half ape, half human creature, and scrambles to find a cure.

When bodies start turning up in the streets with the equation w∆z carved into their flesh, Detective Argo (Skarsgård) and his new partner (George) realise that each victim is being offered a gruesome choice - kill your loved ones or be killed.
On the run and with nowhere to hide, a group of mercenaries find themselves surrounded by an unidentified enemy.
Chaos descends when a mysterious pulse turns cell phone users into vicious predators. Desperate to reunite with his family, Clay teams up with survivors to battle the hordes of relentless killers!
When a young girl buys an antique wooden box, she has no idea of the terror living inside—until the malicious spirit takes possession of her in this gripping tale of horror.

t: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Point of Destruction
d: Four tragic air accidents seem to point to the failure of a fuel diffuser being tested, but Peter suspects sabotage is at play.

t: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Death Cell
d: An escaped mental patient comes to Peter, asking for his help in getting her fiancͩ  cleared of a murder charge as he awaits execution.

t: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: The Vanishing Evidence
d: A European spy kills a British professor and steals vital papers. M.I.5 recruits Peter to go to to Amsterdam and recover the scientific research.

t: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: The Prize
d: In Scandinavia, at a prize-awarding ceremony, Peter must rescue a writer being held for speaking out against her repressive government.

t: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Flight into Darkness
d: Dr. Stephens believes his anti-gravity research will endanger mankind; he destroys the papers and disappears. Brady is summoned to track him down.

t: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Decoy
d: Identical twins Toni and Terry Trent are a popular musical act, performing for the troops on a USO tour of Britain. Brady volunteers to help Toni when Terry disappears at a Soho hotel where she had earlier witnessed a murder.

t: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: The White Rabbit
d: French authorities call Peter when a doctor brings in a white rabbit she says materialized out of thin air before her eyes.

t: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Man in Disguise
d: The Invisible man is investigating an international drug ring when his identity is stolen by a beautiful young woman and used to smuggle drugs.

t: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: The Gun Runners
d: Terrorists in an Italian market gun down a family. This sparks an investigation into how the killers got the guns, which Peter is tasked with.

t: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Man in Power
d: Brady aids the heirs of a Middle East king, who has been murdered by his power-crazy army chief to regain their father's throne.

t: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Shadow Bomb
d: Peter is called in after a malfunction with a light sensitive bomb and must disarm the weapon before approaching darkness makes detonation inevitable.

t: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: The Big Plot
d: Found among the wreckage of a crashed plane are parts of an atomic bomb and Peter uncovers a plot to start a Third World War.
